title: Accelerated stochastic first-order method for convex optimization under heavy-tailed noise
abstract: arXiv:2510.11676v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study convex composite optimization problems, where the objective function is given by the sum of a prox-friendly function and a convex function whose subgradients are estimated under heavy-tailed noise. Existing work often employs gradient clipping or normalization techniques in stochastic first-order methods to address heavy-tailed noise. %In this paper, we demonstrate that a vanilla stochastic algorithm---without additional modifications such as clipping or normalization---can achieve optimal complexity for these problems. In this paper, we analyze the first-order oracle complexity of vanilla stochastic algorithms---without additional modifications such as clipping or normalization---for solving these problems. In particular, we establish that an accelerated stochastic proximal subgradient method achieves a first-order oracle complexity for finding an approximate optimal solution in expectation that is universally optimal

translated_title: 重尾噪声下凸优化的加速随机一阶方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究凸复合优化问题，其目标函数由一个易于近端计算的函数与一个凸函数之和构成，其中该凸函数的次梯度是在重尾噪声下估计得到的。现有工作通常在随机一阶方法中采用梯度裁剪或归一化技术来应对重尾噪声。本文分析了原始（vanilla）随机算法——即无需诸如裁剪或归一化等额外修改——求解此类问题的一阶预言机复杂度。特别地，我们证明了一种加速随机近端次梯度方法在期望意义下寻找近似最优解所达到的一阶预言机复杂度是普遍最优的。
tldr: 本文证明无需梯度裁剪或归一化等额外修改的原始加速随机近端次梯度方法，即可在重尾噪声下的凸复合优化中达到普遍最优的一阶预言机复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that a vanilla accelerated stochastic proximal subgradient method—without modifications such as clipping or normalization—achieves universally optimal first-order oracle complexity for convex composite optimization under heavy-tailed noise.
